meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For **oily skin in India under ₹500**, my top pick is:

### [Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser]()
*₹270*

### My picks

1. **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Cleanser — ~₹270–₹299** ⭐ Best overall  
   Good if you have oily skin, clogged pores or occasional pimples. It combines salicylic acid + LHA and is fragrance-free/non-comedogenic. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/acne-control/products/salicylic-lha-2-cleanser?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

2. **The Derma Co 1% Salicylic Acid Face Wash — ~₹239** — Better if your skin is somewhat sensitive but still oily.

3. **Cipla Saslic DS — ~₹399–₹460** — A stronger pharmacy-style option for oily/acne-prone skin; it contains salicylic acid and is formulated around pH 5.5. [www.1mg.com](https://www.1mg.com/otc/saslic-salicylic-acid-foaming-face-wash-ph-5.5-for-acne-prone-skin-otc60073?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [The Derma Co 1% Salicylic Acid Gel Face Wash]()
*₹239*

### [Cipla Saslic DS Foaming Face Wash]()
*₹399*

### [Chemist At Play Oil & Acne Control Face Wash]()
*₹239*

**What I'd buy:** Minimalist if your main issue is **oil + blackheads/pimples**. Use it once daily initially; if your skin becomes tight, dry or irritated, reduce frequency.

If you tell me whether you have **pimples/blackheads** and whether your skin is **very oily or just mildly oily**, I can narrow it down to one.
